name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Added Purchase Challan (Goods Receipt Note / GRN) workflow for inward physical stock tracking
Immediate physical inventory stock incrementation upon goods receipt
Isolated supplier payable liability and accounting vouchers until formal bill conversion
1-tap conversion from Purchase Challan to Purchase Bill without duplicate stock incrementation
Automatic physical stock reversion upon challan cancellation or deletion of unconverted challans
Added Purchase Challans view with KPI metrics, status filters, transport metadata tracking, and preview modal
